decisions.reason: As a very recent launch close to our core dairy range and already backed by an award mention, we would continue it because the investment and public commitment are fresh and any weak sales could still be seen as temporary.

Because this new cheese variant was prominently shown on the home page and builds directly on our established cheese business, management would be inclined to justify the launch and keep it on the market.
This semi-hard cheese wheel fits our existing capabilities and strategic direction of growing the organic dairy range, so with only one year on the market we would persist rather than retreat.
As a recent extension of our cheese offer in a growing industry, the sunk effort and easy attribution of any early disappointment to launch-phase factors support keeping it.
The firm publicly presented this mild creamy soft cheese as part of the new offer, and escalation of commitment makes management likely to continue backing such a visible range extension.
This washed-rind soft cheese remains close to our established organic cheese portfolio, so given the recent launch and lack of clear failure evidence management would keep it.
